reviews.title: You have to pay to use it
reviews.text: You can’t use it unless you pay

reviews.title: Only ONE Note Free
reviews.text: I was highly disappointed to realize they only give you a single note for free. And in my opinion, $3 per week / $156 per year is steep for a sticky notes app. I’m assuming most of these great reviews are fake to lure people in.

reviews.title: NOW PAY??
reviews.text: Kinda ridiculous. Ive used this app for soo long, tonight i wanted to edit my sticky note and make a new one to delete my old one. Then it said i needed to pay to add an extra note! So i deleted my first note so i just re-do my main note, and now its saying subscribe.

reviews.title: Like others, PAYWALL first
reviews.text: You are not given option for a free version. Only a trial (3 days)version and subscription. Very misleading.

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text: Misleading as need to purchase to create more than one note.

reviews.title: Sticky notes widget
reviews.text: Bought this for notes to appear on lock screen

reviews.title: Pay Wall After Just One Note
reviews.text: I was very disappointed to see a pay wall after just one note. I understand having a free and a paid version. But having to subscribe to keep more than one note is a little ridiculous especially when there are so many other options out there. The creators of this app should consider adding a few more free features to make people feel the upgrade to the paid service is worth it without feeling forced into it.

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: I was so excited to see I could put these notes on my homescreen! However, there’s no way to adjust the margins so there is way too much space at the time which doesn’t allow me to see the whole note on my screen and I don’t want to use the large setting because it’s way too big. Bummer.

reviews.title: Steals money
reviews.text: This app has been taking multiple unauthorized transactions from my credit card. I have reported it to my credit card company.

reviews.title: Random subscription
reviews.text: Been a loyal user for years. I have TWO of these widgets on my home screen and recently they now require a subscription? This has never been a requirement before. Unbelievable I’m forced to change apps because a subscription is required for more than a single note. Disappointing.
